data.title: Mule Recruitment Test Deposit Pattern
data.description: Detects accounts receiving multiple small "test" deposits from many distinct external sources. Mule recruiters validate new mule accounts by sending micro-deposits from various fraud proceeds before routing larger amounts. The pattern of many small inbound transfers from unrelated senders is highly anomalous for personal accounts.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Mule Recruitment Test Deposit Pattern")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_small_deposits | count(distinct originator_id) by account_id > 8")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:ach_processing
(event_type="ACH_CREDIT" OR event_type="P2P_CREDIT" OR event_type="WIRE_CREDIT")
transaction_amount<=100
transaction_amount>=1
| stats dc(originator_id) as unique_originator_id by account_id
| where unique_originator_id > 8

falsepositives: Account verification micro-deposits from legitimate fintech platforms linking accounts
Social media influencers receiving many small tips or donations
